newsitem.title: USA: National Diagnostics, NASDAQ, in talks.
newsitem.headline: National Diagnostics, NASDAQ, in talks.

text.p: National Diagnostics Inc said Thursday that it is currently in discussions with NASDAQ regarding the market listing requirements and the company's capital surplus.

The company said the talks center around the evaluation of Equisure Inc common shares carried on the company's balance sheet. Trading in the shares was halted by the American Stock Exchange on Aug. 4.

The company added that it intended to use the securities to obtain additional working capital, which will be difficult to obtain while trading is halted. It also said that there are provisions in the transaction by which it obtained the stock to eliminate any market risk.
The company provides full service diagnostic imaging services through outpatient centers and mobile facilities located in Florida.
